name: Defensores del Chaco National Park
story: Defensores del Chaco National Park is the largest protected area in Paraguay, covering 720,000 hectares. Created on 6 August 1975, the park covers a vast plain with low forests, thorn bushes, and cactus. It is home to large mammals like the jaguar, puma, and South American tapir.
matters: The park is part of the Paraguayan Chaco, which is the part of the Gran Chaco within Paraguay. The region features high ecological diversity and supports various species.
